button.name: action_finalize
button.confirm: Finalise the statement? It runs all checks again; afterwards the statement, its values and inputs can no longer be changed, only corrected by a new version.

sheet.div: There is no form data of the year yet: the statement is provisional on the forms of an earlier year and cannot be finalised (F-13).

div.p: Finalised statements, their values, inputs and payload cannot be changed or deleted. Keep them with the receipts for at least 10 years (§ 147 (3) AO), longer while the assessment period is still open. Check Integrity computes the hashes again.

sheet.div:
This version is superseded by
and stays unchanged and readable.
A correction of this statement is in progress; this version stays valid until the correction is finalised.

page.name: questionnaire
page.p: Answer every question. A manager confirms the questionnaire; answers proposed from the previous year are no confirmation. A case outside the program scope blocks the finalisation (R-52).

page.name: cash
page.p: Enter the balance of the statement of account at 31 December for every money journal and attach the statement. A missing or different balance blocks the finalisation (G-17).

button.name: action_take_over_private_use
button.invisible: state not in ('draft', 'computed') or not private_use_ids

page.name: outputs
page.p: All outputs show the values of this statement. The fill-in aid lists only fields with a value in the order of the official form; enter the values in Mein ELSTER yourself. It is no form for a paper filing.

button.name: action_export_elster
button.string: List of the Kennzahlen for ELSTER (CSV)

field.name: help
field.p: Create the statement of a year
Answer the questionnaire, compute the year, classify open rests, decide the review of the turn of the year, reconcile the bank at 31 December, check and enter the values in Mein ELSTER.

field.name: amount
field.invisible: kind not in ('car_private_use', 'withdrawal_in_kind', 'withdrawal_vat', 'tax_free', 'income_in_kind') and not (kind == 'use_contribution' and method == 'actual')
